claims.claim: This case is stated entirely in RC verbs primitives (QPEx, MR, Type-2 MW, rkey, RDMA write, and work-completion status) and asserts no Ethernet, IP-route, or RoCE-mode rule; it is a generic RDMA access/lifecycle case rather than a RoCE configuration case.
QpExRCBindMw creates an RC extended QP with RDMA-write and bind-MW send operations, and registers its MR with remote-write and MW-bind access in addition to local write.
The test allocates a Type-2 MW, increments its rkey, and binds the full MR through MWBindInfo carrying only IBV_ACCESS_LOCAL_WRITE before requiring a successful bind completion.
An RDMA write using the restricted MW rkey is accepted for posting but the polled client completion must have status IBV_WC_REM_ACCESS_ERR; any other status raises PyverbsRDMAError.
EOPNOTSUPP while creating the extended QP player or allocating the MW is converted to SkipTest, so an unsupported device is not evidence that the denial behavior passed.
Test teardown closes both endpoint contexts; Context.close closes dependent weak references before closing the device, while the MW is retained by its PD and QP and deallocated by MW.close.
